task: LoRA fine-tune of an open model on Baahar briefings, on a Modal GPU
why_modal: The CPU run took over 40 minutes of wall clock and was making the laptop unusable. Modal runs the training loop on a remote GPU. Same measurement as fine_tune_local.py.
not_a_tinker_run: This does not claim the Tinker prize category. Tinker's API is verified reachable but its balance is exhausted and recharging requires a card. See docs/adr/001-tinker-outcome.md.
loss: mean token-level cross-entropy, assistant tokens only

caveats: The targets were written by the deterministic local writer, so a low loss means the model learned that writer's template. This is style transfer, not evidence that the prose is good; the briefing rubric in eval/RESULTS.md remains the only measurement of readability.
Single seed, single configuration (lora_rank=16, learning_rate=0.0002, epochs=3). One point on a hyper-parameter surface, not a tuned result.
22 validation examples is a small held-out set; a few-hundredths move should not be read as decisive.
This held-out set is 22 briefing examples, not the tabular holdout. The two are not comparable.
